mapper.select: select id from member_invite_code where code_hash = #{codeHash} and status = 'active' and expires_at > current_timestamp for update

select mic.id as "inviteId", mic.tenant_id as "tenantId", mic.member_id as "memberId", mic.expires_at as "expiresAt", m.name as "memberName", s.name as "storeName", s.address, s.contact_phone as "contactPhone", coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'cardId', mc.id, 'cardName', ct.name, 'cardType', mc.card_type, 'remainCount', mc.remain_count, 'validUntil', mc.valid_until )) filter (where mc.id is not null), '[]') as cards from member_invite_code mic join member m on m.id = mic.member_id join store s on s.id = mic.store_id left join member_card mc on mc.member_id = m.id and mc.tenant_id = mic.tenant_id left join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id where mic.code_hash = #{codeHash} and mic.status = 'active' and mic.expires_at > current_timestamp group by mic.id, m.id, s.id
select openid from member_wechat_identity where id = #{identityId} for update
mapper.update: update member_invite_code set status = 'used', bound_openid = #{openid}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{inviteId} and status = 'active' and expires_at > current_timestamp
update member_wechat_identity set tenant_id = #{tenantId}, member_id = #{memberId}, last_login_at = current_timestamp where id = #{identityId} and member_id is null
mapper.select: select tenant_id as "tenantId", member_id as "memberId" from member_wechat_identity where id = #{identityId} and member_id is not null
select count(*) from member_card where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and base_status = 'active' and valid_until >= current_date and (card_type = 'period' or remain_count > 0)

select count(*) from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and b.member_id = #{memberId} and b.status = 'reserved' and bs.start_at > current_timestamp

select m.id, m.name, m.member_no as "memberNo", m.contact_text as "contactText", s.id as "storeId", s.name as "storeName", s.address, s.contact_phone as "contactPhone", t.status as "tenantStatus", coalesce(sw.wechat_id, dsw.wechat_id) as "supportWechatId" from member m join store s on s.id = m.store_id join tenant t on t.id = m.tenant_id left join support_wechat sw on sw.tenant_id = t.id and sw.enabled left join support_wechat dsw on dsw.tenant_id is null and dsw.enabled where m.id = #{memberId} and m.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select mc.id, ct.name, mc.card_type as "cardType", mc.remain_count as "remainCount", mc.valid_from as "validFrom", mc.valid_until as "validUntil", case when mc.base_status = 'suspended' then 'suspended' when mc.valid_until < current_date then 'expired' when mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count = 0 then 'empty' when mc.valid_until <= current_date + cast(pc.value_text as integer) then 'expiring' when mc.card_type = 'count' and mc.remain_count <= ct.low_balance_threshold then 'low_balance' else 'active' end as status, coalesce(string_agg(distinct si.name, '、'), '') as "serviceScope", coalesce(string_agg(distinct sa.staff_name, '、'), '') as "staffScope" from member_card mc join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id cross join platform_config pc left join card_template_service_scope css on css.card_template_id = ct.id left join service_item si on si.id = css.service_item_id left join card_template_staff_scope cts on cts.card_template_id = ct.id left join staff_account sa on sa.id = cts.staff_account_id where mc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and mc.member_id = #{memberId} and pc.config_key = 'member_card.expiring_warn_days' group by mc.id, ct.id, pc.value_text order by mc.valid_until, mc.id

select bs.id as "slotId", si.id as "serviceId", si.name as "serviceName", si.service_type as "serviceType", si.duration_min as "durationMin", sa.id as "staffId", sa.staff_name as "staffName", r.name as "resourceName", bs.start_at as "startAt", bs.end_at as "endAt", bs.capacity, bs.reserved_count as "reservedCount", (bs.capacity - bs.reserved_count) as "availableCount", bs.cancel_deadline_min as "cancelDeadlineMin" from bookable_slot bs join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id join staff_account sa on sa.id = bs.staff_account_id join resource r on r.id = bs.resource_id where bs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.status = 'published' and bs.start_at > current_timestamp order by bs.start_at

select mc.id, ct.name, mc.card_type as "cardType", mc.remain_count as "remainCount", si.deduct_count as "deductCount", mc.valid_until as "validUntil" from bookable_slot bs join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id join member_card mc on mc.tenant_id = bs.tenant_id and mc.member_id = #{memberId} join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id where bs.id = #{slotId} and bs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bs.status = 'published' and mc.base_status = 'active' and mc.valid_from <= current_date and mc.valid_until >= current_date and (mc.card_type = 'period' or mc.remain_count >= si.deduct_count) and exists( select 1 from card_template_service_scope css where css.card_template_id = ct.id and css.service_item_id = bs.service_item_id ) and (not exists( select 1 from card_template_staff_scope cts0 where cts0.card_template_id = ct.id ) or exists( select 1 from card_template_staff_scope cts where cts.card_template_id = ct.id and cts.staff_account_id = bs.staff_account_id )) order by mc.valid_until, mc.id
mapper.update: update bookable_slot set reserved_count = reserved_count + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{slotId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'published' and start_at > current_timestamp and reserved_count < capacity
mapper.select: select b.id, b.status, si.name as "serviceName", sa.staff_name as "staffName", r.name as "resourceName", bs.start_at as "startAt", bs.end_at as "endAt", ct.name as "cardName" from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id join staff_account sa on sa.id = bs.staff_account_id join resource r on r.id = bs.resource_id join member_card mc on mc.id = b.member_card_id join card_template ct on ct.id = mc.template_id where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and b.member_id = #{memberId} order by bs.start_at desc

select dr.id, dr.deduct_count as "deductCount", dr.before_count as "beforeCount", dr.after_count as "afterCount", dr.deducted_at as "deductedAt", si.name as "serviceName", sn.staff_note_text as "staffNoteText", sn.member_feedback_text as "memberFeedbackText" from deduction_record dr join booking b on b.id = dr.booking_id join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id left join service_note sn on sn.booking_id = b.id where dr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dr.member_id = #{memberId} order by dr.deducted_at desc

select b.id, si.name as "serviceName", sa.staff_name as "staffName", r.name as "resourceName", bs.start_at as "startAt", bs.end_at as "endAt" from booking b join bookable_slot bs on bs.id = b.bookable_slot_id join service_item si on si.id = bs.service_item_id join staff_account sa on sa.id = bs.staff_account_id join resource r on r.id = bs.resource_id where b.id = #{bookingId} and b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and b.member_id = #{memberId}
